name: Cogent Communications, Inc.

profile.reading: Cogent Communications Holdings is a publicly traded multinational internet service provider and Tier 1 network operator, listed on NASDAQ under ticker CCOI and filing with the SEC under CIK 0001158324. Cogents core business is IP transit and network connectivity delivered over its own fiber backbone, and its Phoenix, Arizona facility functions as a network point of presence and small colocation data center supporting that network business, with third-party directories placing its capacity at roughly 12 megawatts. Unlike the wholesale and hyperscale developers elsewhere in this registry, Cogents data center facilities exist primarily to support its own network operations and to offer colocation to customers who want to connect directly to Cogents IP transit service, rather than functioning as a standalone real estate leasing business. As a publicly traded, SEC-reporting company, Cogents overall corporate financials are well documented, though facility-specific capacity figures for individual sites like Phoenix are drawn from third-party data center directories rather than Cogents own public disclosures, which focus on network and financial metrics rather than site-level specifications. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
